# Mermaid Live Editor & Diagram Studio
> High-performance client-side live editor and generator for Mermaid.js diagrams, flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and architecture graphs.

## Canonical URL
https://ahmedelazabdev.github.io/mermaidliveeditor/

## Core Functionality
- **Real-Time Rendering:** Converts plain-text Markdown-inspired Mermaid code into crisp vector graphics in the browser.
- **Privacy & Security:** Zero backend tracking or data transmissions; 100% client-side rendering.
- **Supported Standards:** Flowcharts, Sequence Diagrams, Class Diagrams, State Diagrams, Entity-Relationship Models (ERD), Gantt Charts, and User Journeys.
- **Visual Themes:** Default, Neutral, Forest, and Dark mode rendering.
- **High-Resolution Exports:** Infinite-scale vector SVG and 2x high-density PNG file generation.

## Supported Mermaid Diagram Types & Starting Syntax

### 1. Flowchart (Architecture & Decisions)
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Start] --> B{Is Valid?}
    B -- Yes --> C[Process]
    B -- No --> D[Error]
